message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV directly with pd.read_csv and pipes it through transformation functions without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local CSV file with no remote fetch, so no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check is present or needed for a remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only fills nulls, engineers features, and encodes columns; there is no validation of label distributions, expected label sets, or label-noise detection tooling.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs only basic null-filling and feature engineering with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded; models are instantiated directly from scikit-learn classes, so no integrity verification is applicable or present.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor defense mechanisms such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although sklearn metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, f1) are imported and train_test_split is available, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or any mechanism to prevent metric manipulation in the visible code.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads a CSV directly and applies only data-cleaning transformations (fillna, type conversions); there are no input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range probabilities, or calibrated thresholds before returning results to the user.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML classifiers (KNN, SVM, Random Forest, Decision Tree) rather than an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
